pois.name: Beebe-125 black smokers
pois.note: Local scan marker on GMRT seabed at about 4,988 m. Webber et al. (2015), reporting the February 2013 survey, identify Beebe-125 on the southern margin of the westernmost sulfide mound and report 401–403 °C fluid at about 500 bar. This marker uses the field vicinity and local terrain; it does not establish an exact surveyed Beebe-125 footprint.

pois.name: Rimicaris hybisae swarm
pois.note: Real GMRT terrain, -4,979.2 m, ~57 m from the main vent POI, inside the same real vent complex where Nye et al. (2012) described Rimicaris hybisae swarming by the thousand around Beebe's chimneys. `reconstruction: true` because no published survey gives exact individual-shrimp or swarm-density coordinates to place -- the swarm's real presence at this vent field is sourced, its precise mapped position here is not.

pois.name: Western sulfide mound
pois.note: Real GMRT terrain, -4,957.1 m, about 346 m southwest of the main vent POI. Webber et al. (2015) describe at least six sulfide mounds; this marker is an authored local target, not the surveyed coordinate of a specific mound.
